entities.name: B0K8K4
observations: Exact sequence match to supplied 316-aa sequence; reviewed UniProt entry annotates phospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide-transferase, EC 2.7.8.13.
Transfers UDP-MurNAc-pentapeptide precursor to undecaprenyl phosphate, producing lipid I and UMP; Mg2+ listed as cofactor.
Rhea reaction RHEA:28386; membrane-localized, multipass protein involved in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: RHEA:28386
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine + undecaprenyl phosphate → undecaprenyl diphospho-MurNAc-pentapeptide (lipid I) + UMP.
